name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A set of habits you install into your AI coding assistant so it plans properly, writes a spec, tests its own work, and keeps working for hours without wandering off track.
buyer: A technical founder or engineering lead who already uses an AI coding assistant daily but is tired of babysitting it through every small decision.
business_use_cases: A solo technical founder installs it so their AI assistant can run an overnight feature build unattended instead of needing check-ins every ten minutes.
A dev agency standardizes every client engagement on this methodology so junior staff get senior-level discipline (specs, tests, reviews) baked into their AI workflow for free.
A bootcamp or course creator uses it as the backbone of a 'how to actually work with AI coding agents' curriculum.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid setup and customization of the methodology for teams adopting AI coding agents.
Run a paid course or cohort teaching the subagent-driven development workflow it encodes.

steal_this: Install it on your own current project this weekend, run one real feature through the full plan-then-build loop, and write up the before/after as a case study to sell AI-adoption consulting.
